statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The claim was denied based on reason code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
SilverBridge Advantage requires prior approval for this specific diagnostic procedure
